load_vocab_json: load a JSON vocabulary file into a Python dictionary using load_vocab
load_merges_bpe: load a BPE merges file into a list of tuples using load_merges
test_roberta_tokenizer: test the RobertaTokenizer by tokenizing text and converting tokens to IDs
create_roberta_tokenizer_from_vocab: create a RobertaTokenizer instance from a vocab dictionary and merges list
run_roberta_tokenization_tests: run the RobertaTokenizationTest suite to validate tokenizer behavior with integration test data
